description: Queries SAP's cross-reference tables (WBCROSSGT/WBCROSSI) to find what objects use a given object (forward) or what a given object uses (inverse). Equivalent to SAP's 'Where-Used List' functionality. IMPORTANT: For heavily-used tables (MARA, KNA1, LFA1), use name_filter='Z*' to avoid timeout!

direction.description: Query direction: 'forward' finds what uses this object, 'inverse' finds what this object uses

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (max: 1000)

name_filter.description: Filter pattern for object names (e.g., 'Z*' for custom objects, 'Y*' for Y namespace). Supports * as wildcard. REQUIRED for heavily-used tables like MARA to avoid timeout!

object_name.description: Name of the object to look up (e.g., MARA, BAPI_PO_CREATE, ZCL_MY_CLASS)

name: sap_read_where_used
